questions.question: Dr. Choumi has an assistant on an 8-month fixed-term contract. She becomes pregnant and wishes to take her maternity leave. According to Articles 32 and 159, will the assistant's contract end at its term?
options: No, the contract is automatically suspended during maternity leave
Yes, the fixed-term contract ends at its term, even during maternity leave
Yes, but she may receive compensation
No, the fixed-term contract is automatically converted into a permanent contract
questions.explanation: Article 159, last paragraph, provides that the protective provisions for pregnant women do not prevent the expiry of the fixed-term employment contract.

questions.question: Dr. Farouk wishes to dismiss his assistant after 18 months of work for economic reasons. According to Article 52, is the assistant entitled to severance pay?
options: No, because she has not reached 2 years of seniority
Yes, because she has worked at least 6 months
Yes, but only if the dismissal is for misconduct
No, economic reasons exclude severance pay
questions.explanation: Article 52 provides that an employee bound by an indefinite-term contract is entitled to severance pay in the event of dismissal after six months of work in the same company.

questions.question: Dr. Choumi pays his assistant monthly. According to Article 13, if he wishes to terminate the probation period, what notice period must he respect?
questions.explanation: Article 13 provides that if the employee is paid monthly, a notice period of eight days is required before termination of the probation period.

questions.question: Dr. Farouk has an assistant on a permanent contract. He wishes to suspend her for 5 days as a disciplinary measure. According to Article 37, is this permitted?
options: Yes, without any limit on duration
Yes, but the suspension cannot exceed 8 days
Yes, but only with the employee's agreement
questions.explanation: Article 37 provides for suspension as a disciplinary sanction, for a period not exceeding eight days.

questions.question: Dr. Choumi is considering dismissing his assistant for gross misconduct. According to Article 61, what compensation must he pay her?
options: No compensation, dismissal for gross misconduct exempts from any payment
questions.explanation: Article 61 provides that in the event of gross misconduct, the employee may be dismissed without notice or indemnity or payment of damages.

questions.question: Dr. Farouk, employer of 12 employees, wishes to modify the internal regulations. According to Article 138, what procedure must be followed?
options: He can modify it freely without formalities
He must communicate it to the staff delegates and submit it for ministry approval
He must submit it to a vote of the employees
He must only display it in the practice
questions.explanation: Article 138 requires the employer to communicate the internal regulations to the staff delegates before submitting them for approval by the government authority responsible for labor.

questions.question: According to Article 138, what is the deadline to establish internal regulations after opening a practice employing at least 10 employees?
questions.explanation: Article 138 provides that any employer habitually employing at least ten employees is required, within two years of opening, to establish internal regulations.

questions.question: Dr. Choumi has an assistant who works 44 hours per week. She performs 4 hours of overtime. According to Article 201, at what rate are these hours compensated?
questions.explanation: Article 201 provides for a 25% supplement for overtime worked between 6am and 9pm in non-agricultural activities.

questions.question: Dr. Farouk has an assistant who takes her annual leave. According to Article 247, if the practice closes completely during the leave period, what must the employer do?
options: Pay a leave indemnity to all employees, regardless of seniority
Pay an indemnity only to employees with more than 6 months of seniority
questions.explanation: Article 247 provides that all employees receive paid annual leave indemnity corresponding to the duration of the closure, regardless of the duration of their service at the time of closure.

questions.question: Dr. Choumi, employer of 15 employees, wishes to know his obligations regarding staff delegates. According to Article 433, how many delegates must he have?
questions.explanation: Article 433 provides that from 10 to 25 employees, the company must elect one titular delegate and one alternate delegate.

questions.question: Dr. Farouk has an employee who constantly complains about noise. According to Article 281, what is the employer's obligation regarding working conditions?
options: Ensure that the premises provide adequate hygiene and safety conditions
questions.explanation: Article 281 requires the employer to ensure that the workplace provides the hygiene and safety conditions necessary for the health of employees.

questions.question: Dr. Choumi is an employer of 60 employees. According to Article 304, what obligation does he have regarding occupational medical services?
options: Create an independent occupational medical service
Just provide a first aid kit
questions.explanation: Article 304 requires the creation of an independent occupational medical service for companies employing at least fifty employees.

questions.question: According to Article 336, must Dr. Farouk, employer of 60 employees, create a safety and health committee?
questions.explanation: Article 336 provides for the creation of safety and health committees in companies employing at least 50 employees.

questions.question: Dr. Choumi wishes to hire a foreign employee. According to Article 516, what procedure must be followed?
options: He must obtain authorization from the government authority responsible for labor
He must first publish an advertisement in Morocco
He must obtain approval from the Ministry of Interior
questions.explanation: Article 516 requires any employer wishing to recruit a foreign employee to obtain authorization from the government authority responsible for labor.

questions.question: According to Article 526, Dr. Farouk must retire his employees who reach the age of:
questions.explanation: Article 526 provides that any employee who reaches the age of sixty must be retired.

questions.question: Dr. Choumi has an employee who resigned. According to Article 72, within what period must he issue the work certificate?
questions.explanation: Article 72 requires the employer to issue the work certificate within a maximum period of eight days, under penalty of damages.

questions.question: According to Article 15, the employment contract must be established in how many copies?
questions.explanation: Article 15 provides that the employment contract must be established in two copies bearing the signatures of the employee and the employer.

questions.question: Dr. Farouk has an employee who refuses to perform dangerous work. According to Article 293, can the employee be sanctioned?
options: Yes, if they have been duly informed of the risks
No, they can refuse any work
questions.explanation: Article 293 provides that employees duly informed of safety requirements who do not comply with them are liable to sanctions.

questions.question: According to Article 172, what is the age limit for night work for minors?
questions.explanation: Article 172 prohibits employing minors under sixteen years of age in night work, subject to exceptions.

questions.question: Dr. Choumi wishes to have his assistant work overtime on a Sunday. According to Article 205, is this permitted?
questions.explanation: Article 205 requires weekly rest of at least twenty-four hours, which must be granted to employees.

questions.question: Dr. Farouk has an employee on a permanent contract who wishes to resign. According to Article 34, what is his right?
options: He can resign by a letter with legalized signature
He must wait until the end of the year
He must pay an indemnity to the employer
questions.explanation: Article 34 provides that the employee may terminate the permanent contract by means of a resignation bearing a signature legalized by the competent authority.

questions.question: According to Article 33, in the event of early termination of a fixed-term contract without gross misconduct, the damages correspond to:
options: The period from termination to the end of the contract
questions.explanation: Article 33 provides that the amount of damages is equivalent to the salaries corresponding to the period from the date of termination to the end of the contract.

questions.question: Dr. Choumi, employer of 25 employees, must organize staff delegate elections. According to Article 438, who is an elector?
options: Employees aged 16 and over with at least 6 months of work
questions.explanation: Article 438 provides that electors are employees of both sexes aged sixteen and over who have worked at least six months in the establishment.

questions.question: According to Article 446, Dr. Farouk is required to display the lists of candidates for delegate functions. Where must he display them?
options: In the locations provided by regulation
questions.explanation: Article 446 requires the employer to display the lists of candidates in the locations provided by regulation.

questions.question: Dr. Choumi has an employee who committed gross misconduct. According to Article 62, within what period must he hear the employee?
questions.explanation: Article 62 provides that the employee must be heard within a period not exceeding eight days from the date of notification of the act attributed to them.
